simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַחֲנֵה־דָן (H4265) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מַחֲנֵה־דָן (Machănêh-Dân) means Machaneh-Dan , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 18 12.

definitions.full: H4265. Machaneh -dan מַחֲנֵהדָֿ֑ן proper name, of a location = camp of Dan , name given, Judg 13:25 ; 18:12 , to place where Danites encamped (see Bla).
